caseNameFull: Miller, Director, Department of Children and Family Services of Illinois v. Youakim

opinions.text:
C. A. 7th Cir. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 434 U. S. 1060.] Motion of American Orthopsychiatric Assn, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted.
